Name: Guardian
Description: The Tank archetype: draw the enemy's eye and shrug off what lands.

Nodes.Name: Shield Wall
Nodes.Description: Learn to bash a foe off balance and open its guard.

Nodes.Name: Iron Will
Nodes.Description: Shake off venom before it takes hold.

Nodes.Name: Unbreakable
Nodes.Description: Physical blows land at 70% — a hide no blade bites deep.

Nodes.Name: Vigilance
Nodes.Description: Read a foe's resistances and weaknesses before the line breaks.

Nodes.Name: Last Bastion
Nodes.Description: Anything that lands a blow on you pays for it.

Name: Warrior
Description: The Striker archetype: close the distance and keep swinging.

Nodes.Name: Cleaving Strikes
Nodes.Description: A wide swing that catches more than one foe.

Nodes.Name: Battle Fury
Nodes.Description: A war cry that hardens the whole line.

Nodes.Name: Relentless Assault
Nodes.Description: Every pincer strike lands twice.

Nodes.Name: Bloodlust
Nodes.Description: Below half HP, every hit lands 35% harder.

Nodes.Name: Undying Rampage
Nodes.Description: Every landed blow heals for half the damage it deals.

Name: Ranger
Description: The Ranged archetype: never needs to be adjacent to strike.

Nodes.Name: Focused Aim
Nodes.Description: A called shot that picks the deadliest opening.

Nodes.Name: Covering Fire
Nodes.Description: Pin down a whole line or column from range.

Nodes.Name: Deadeye
Nodes.Description: Every shot looses twice before the string settles.

Nodes.Name: Hunter's Resilience
Nodes.Description: Field-worn leathers turn physical blows aside — they land at 70%.

Name: Mage
Description: The Mage archetype: ranged elemental AoE damage.

Nodes.Name: Arcane Bolt
Nodes.Description: A fast, reliable bolt of raw mana.

Nodes.Name: Chilling Frost
Nodes.Description: Ice that locks a square of the field in place.

Nodes.Name: Meteor Storm
Nodes.Description: A slow-charging strike that levels a wide area.

Nodes.Name: Shockwave
Nodes.Description: A burst that catches everything adjacent to its center.

Nodes.Name: Archmage's Focus
Nodes.Description: Mana discipline that knits a little strength back every turn.

Name: Cleric
Description: The Healer archetype: mend and cleanse.

Nodes.Name: Mending Light
Nodes.Description: A wash of light that heals the whole party at once.

Nodes.Name: Sacred Cleanse
Nodes.Description: Purge poison from an ally's blood.

Nodes.Name: Rejuvenation
Nodes.Description: A deeper, slower-fading restoration.

Nodes.Name: Devout Resolve
Nodes.Description: Faith hardens the body — physical blows land at 70%.

Nodes.Name: Divine Vigor
Nodes.Description: A standing blessing that knits wounds every turn.

Name: Alchemist
Description: The Support archetype: tempo, tonics and field remedies.

Nodes.Name: Quickening Brew
Nodes.Description: A tonic that hastens an ally's next turn.

Nodes.Name: Binding Toxin
Nodes.Description: A reagent that slows whatever it touches.

Nodes.Name: Tonic Mastery
Nodes.Description: A standing regeneration draught.

Nodes.Name: Field Remedies
Nodes.Description: Cure venom with reagents pulled straight from the pack.

Nodes.Name: Elixir of Vigor
Nodes.Description: A reagent blend potent enough to mend wounds every turn, unasked.
